title: MZ My current project as a complete noob with RPG MAKER [With questions]

posts.author: Jeenah
posts.body:
Hello there ! I'm brand new and decided to create my own RPG to adapt one of the Novels i wrote to a better support for the story i wanna tell.
I created a post on another section before i actually tryed the software to ask some questions (just to be sure), but i don't think talking about my project would be fitting there so this new thread will have multiple purposes. I think its better to have it in general discussions, than elsewhere because ... Well. Its general. AH AH !
This topic will have those in mind :
-> My struggles as a complete noob, but not unfamiliar with Java, Spriting, scripts or other small works. (I created a mod for another game [Starsector] already that uses massive 2D topdown view pixelated shipsprites) => Not without help. But managed to get it to work. Somehow. With custom weapons, etc ...
-> My questions about issues i could encounter (Despite having encountered some already, i could fix them myself).
-> The advancement of this small project.
The content of the project, and mainly the objectives for the game :
-> Crafting system (Drops from monsters, and resource gathering).
-> Animated sideview battler (Already mounted), not without some struggles. Found a really good suit of plugins to do what i want. I'm gonna stick with it ! (For free)
-> A lot of companions (Mostly beasts, creatures and monsters) since the main character will be a beast charmer (Not a tamer. I prefer the term charmer for him since those creatures would still have their own free will, BUT would be chill with its existence. His powers would be like a pacifier for monsters [Only the smart ones/most intelligent or self-conscious ones and on very special conditions])
-> Planting crops and harvesting (To craft potions with medicinal plants).
-> Quests (Easy to make as i could see from some tutorials).
-> Scripted encounters and events (Story heavy moments).
-> All the maps will be interconnected and the player will be able to traverse the entire world from side to side while having some fast travel possibilities (I wont create a world map as it was said to be too hard and probably annoying to do, so that part will be skipped) => Its not necessary for the story anyway.
Spawn map (Start of game), not yet completed with the events and harvestable resources but i think i'm at 70% completion for this one. There's also a tiny cave with some bats in here.

cursed

Window_Command
or
Window_HorzCommand

As to managing spaces and the like, you absolutely can still have that. I personally use Visual Studio Code for it, but any good text editor should either have a JavaScript autoformatter, or at least allow you to install one as an extension.

ANYWAY ! I come with a special question. I'm tackling (Rugbyman fashion) the text window, i want to make a beautiful custom window (Installed the VisuaStella plugin which offer some customizations already and QoL improvments that were very needed)

posts.body:
Time for the Twon
(Yep voluntary typo, i like this word).
-> First little combat event have been done.
-> Town going strong. Four interiors have been done.
-> The forest map got some new trees and mini-locations for more variety. Its even better now !
To do :
-> Finish the first town.
-> Do the mandatory event chain. Which will be a pain.
-> Add an image to simulate the sunrays coming from the West-South (To make the shadows render even better).
For this event chain, well. Gotta hope i don't  it up completly.
Today's program :
-> Change all the directions the characters face are ... Facing. AH AH ! (Nearly done already).
-> Finish the first story-chain of the game (With two quests, multiple events and two important characters).
-> Modify the expressions of multiple characters + add expressions to the main character also (Nearly finished already).
-> Fix multiple mini-issues with textbox and faces (Done).
Bonus :
-> Implement crafting system ...
A little screenshot of the first village. (Starter village)
It is meant to be small and scarce in houses, AND people.
Where sadly, nearly everybody hates you, except one person ! (The game, despite being story driven, will still require the players to explore like in every open-world RPG, and exploring will be rewarded with special interactions with characters that will be redundant throughout the story).
-> And good items to help in your adventure too (Without being a linear exploration).
-> Also. Money will be important. No money. No power.

posts.author: Jeenah
posts.body:
Its been some looong days. And horrible nights because of the permanent noise in the neighborhood ...
First, the heat, next the horrible bed of the lower-floor because unsleepable upstair, THEN stupid neighboors throw a party, then fireworks in the middle of the night after. GIVE ME A BREAK !
SO ! The project is going good and strong.
-> Some plugins added.
-> First quests and the two first allied characters were created.
-> Special spells were created (Special animations for them).
-> Custom sound_effects added.
-> Some lighting effect (Will need work, but still looks good for now).
-> Sidequest added (Unofficial), not mandotary, but good to know a little more about the main character and its situation (Which wont be easy, at all), and how he's treated by people around him also (Very important).
-> Created some ennemies, some are mandatory for the main quest/story, some are bonuses.
-> Prepared a bonus starting dungeon (The map still need to be created, but the entrances are ready).
-> Massive third map, not completed, but going strong. Mandatory for the main quest and the arrival of the character which will unlock a part of the world.
Most importantly, i learned a lot of things already and becoming more accustomed with the software itself, commands and plugins ! The actual game is around 15 minutes of gameplay with events chaining themselves rather quickly.
I'll probably release a pre-pre-alpha test version to get some feedback later.
Getting even better now !
Soon, someone will suffer by testing it. AH AH !
